points.claim: 提出了一种基于图摘要技术的图表示学习模型GSAERU，解决了现有图神经网络模型无法处理动态图的问题。
points.claim_en: Proposed a graph representation learning model GSAERU based on graph summarization technology, solving the problem that existing GNN models cannot handle dynamic graphs.
technical_features: 引入图摘要技术将原图映射到固定规模的新图中
通过图自编码器学习节点表征
利用重构误差训练节点表征
technical_features_en: Introduced graph summarization technology to map the original graph to a fixed-size new graph
Learned node representations using a graph autoencoder
Trained node representations using reconstruction error

points.claim: 提出了一种基于图摘要技术的分布式图神经网络训练框架DSGNN，提高了大规模图神经网络模型的训练效率。
points.claim_en: Proposed a distributed graph neural network training framework DSGNN based on graph summarization technology, improving the training efficiency of large-scale GNN models.
technical_features: 采用领导-工作者模式进行分布式训练
基于边分割的图流划分算法
使用图摘要技术进行小批量训练
technical_features_en: Used a leader-worker mode for distributed training
Mini-batch training based on graph summarization technology

points.claim: GSAERU模型在四个大规模图数据集上的实验表明，其训练速度和内存消耗优于现有方法，性能差距不超过3.5%。
points.claim_en: Experiments on four large-scale graph datasets showed that the GSAERU model had faster training speed and lower memory consumption compared to existing methods, with performance gaps not exceeding 3.5%.
technical_features: 在四个大规模图数据集上进行了大量实验
与现有方法相比，训练速度更快
与现有方法相比，内存消耗更低
technical_features_en: Conducted extensive experiments on four large-scale graph datasets
Had faster training speed compared to existing methods
Had lower memory consumption compared to existing methods

issues.message: 候选通过模型审核不代表已独立验证整篇论文的贡献覆盖，提取范围仍待核查。
